title: Animal Control Officers / Current Staffing and Deployment / Ensure Animal and Residents Safety
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that Council DIRECTS the Los Angeles Animal Services Department to report on its current staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers and what is needed to maintain the level of services that achieve the response time that ensures safety for the animals and residents across the City. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: ovuik kkucul—6 MONICA RODRIGUEZ J Councilwoman, 7th District OCT 0 6 2026 A

requests.asks: Current staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers, and what is needed to keep response times safe for animals and residents citywide.
